描述_EN: the figure's head is movable. this is a figure of a state official wearing a black hat and holding a box in his hands, standing on a hexagonal plinth, its body made of earthenware with pale green lead glaze. this type of earthenware figure was mass-produced to be buried with the deceased.
描述_ZN: 该人物的头部是可移动的。 这是一个戴着黑色帽子的国家官员，手里拿着一个盒子，站在一个六角形的基座上，它的身体是用淡绿色铅釉的陶器制成的。 这种陶俑是大量生产的，与死者一起埋葬。
